# Breather / 歇会儿

> Free desktop eye break reminder for Apple Silicon macOS 13+ and Windows x64. Local records, no subscriptions. Activity estimates are not gaze detection or medical measurements.

Official website: https://hhf666feng.github.io/Breather/
Public repository: https://github.com/hhf666feng/Breather
License: MIT for original source/documentation; third-party licenses remain separate. https://github.com/hhf666feng/Breather/blob/main/LICENSE
Contributing: https://github.com/hhf666feng/Breather/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
Issues: https://github.com/hhf666feng/Breather/issues
Current macOS version: 1.6.2. Current Windows version: 1.6.0 (Electron 45.3.0).

Data is local by default. Mac users can opt into an automatic backup folder; the app updates EyeWatch-backup.json about every 30 seconds and on key actions. If iCloud Drive is selected, the operating system may sync that file automatically. There is no built-in account, CloudKit cross-device merging or iPhone app.
